findings.location: Paragraph about resistant weeds (source.html paragraph starting "Sure, farmers had several good years...")
findings.source_quote: Today, every farmer knows about ‘Palmer amaranth Pigweed’. You can almost ‘pour’ glyphosate on it, and still it thrives.
findings.suggested_fix: Option A (preferred): Preserve the original proper name but add the conventional target-language botanical/common form in parentheses to aid Spanish readers, e.g. “Palmer amaranth (amaranthus palmeri, conocida como pigweed o ‘Palmer amaranth Pigweed’)”. Option B (minimal): Leave the English name but add a brief Spanish label: “la ‘Palmer amaranth Pigweed’ (una maleza conocida como amaranthus palmeri)”. This keeps the untranslated proper name while giving a clear Spanish reference.
findings.translation_quote: Hoy, todo agricultor conoce la «Palmer amaranth Pigweed». Casi puede uno «verter» glifosato sobre ella y aun así prospera.
